answer: In an agent marketplace selling garden plans, sparrow counts, and zephyr forecasts, each seller must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to receive one job slot. The contract keeps that deposit unavailable until the lock expires, so the same tokens cannot back multiple identities at once. An attacker seeking 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, paying financing costs while gaining no more capacity than equally funded honest sellers.
